source.snippet: First hour with Claude's browser extension: I pointed it at our LLC registration and watched it work... [score: 7, comments: 12, tags: ai, webdev, startup, productivity] — solo operator building AI-assisted browser tooling to automate document-heavy business workflows, describing friction in getting AI assistants to reliably handle real business documents like LLC registrations.

problem_statement: Solo operators and small startup founders waste significant time on repetitive document-heavy business tasks (entity registration, compliance forms, structured data extraction from PDFs) and struggle to get AI browser tools to handle these reliably end-to-end without manual correction.
target_segment: Solo founders and 1-5 person startups doing their own legal/compliance/admin document work
notes: Author is a paying-product builder (tryclicked product implied), 12 comments suggests resonance among peers. Buyer signal is moderate: startup context, productivity framing, existing tool investment. Pain is real but signal is a single dev.to post with limited volume. Would need corroboration from Reddit/IH to raise signal_strength.
